description.value:
The loporrits are small, fluffy, long-eared bipeds hailing from the moon, originally created by Hydaelyn as logistical support, known for boundless energy and organization.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Loporrits gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence and -2 Wisdom.
  • Size: Loporrits are Small creatures.
  • Type: Loporrits are Humanoid creatures with the rabbit subtype.
  • Base Speed: Loporrits have a base speed of 40 feet.
  • Languages: Loporrits begin play speaking Common and Loporrit. Loporrits with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Abyssal, Celestial, Elvaan, Galkan, Goblin, and Orc.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Nimble Faller: Loporrits land on their feet even after falling and gain a +1 bonus to CMD against trip.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Handy: Loporrits receive a +2 racial bonus on a Craft or Profession skill of their choice.
  • Keen Senses: Loporrits receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.
  • Nimble: Loporrits use Dexterity to modify Climb and Swim checks.

Movement Racial Traits

  • Sprinter: Loporrits gain a 10-foot racial bonus to speed when charging, running, or withdrawing.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: Loporrits can see twice as far as humes in dim light.
  • Scent: Loporrits have the scent ability.
